info.name: BrewMemo
info.summary: Fast note app with beautifully crafted mobile Apps
info.description:
BrewMemo is a fast note-taking app with beautifully designed mobile clients.
Your notes are stored securely in your Nextcloud, without any vendor lock-in.
The [iOS App](https://apps.apple.com/de/app/brewmemo/id6514303780?l=en-GB) is available in the App Store, and the [Android App](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=de.brewcode.brewmemo) is available *now* in Google Play.
## Current features:
||Nextcloud|iOS|Android| |-|-|-|-| |Markdown Editor|✅|✅|✅| |WYSIWYG Editor|✅|✅|✅| |Pinning of notes|✅|✅|✅| |Tagging of notes|soon|✅|✅| |Different themes and color styles|planned|✅|✅| |Export notes to PDF and TXT/Markdown|planned|✅|✅| |and many more to come||||
